children.label: quantitative_data
children.description: Numerical data collected through surveys, measurements, and statistical analysis to evaluate the impact and effectiveness of humanitarian interventions.

children.label: qualitative_insights
children.description: In-depth, descriptive information gathered through interviews, focus groups, and observations to understand the experiences and perceptions of affected populations.
example_papers: Mid-term evaluation of the project "Upscaling climate resilience measures in the Dry Corridor agroecosystems of El Salvador (RECLIMA)"

children.label: participatory_data
children.description: Data generated through participatory methods where affected communities are actively involved in the data collection and analysis process, ensuring their voices and perspectives are central to the evaluation.

children.label: administrative_data
children.description: Information derived from existing records and databases maintained by humanitarian organizations, governments, and other institutions to assess program performance and service delivery.

children.label: indigenous_knowledge
children.description: Traditional and local knowledge systems and practices that are integrated into the evaluation process to provide context-specific insights and enhance the cultural relevance of humanitarian interventions.
